  <h1 id="profile-title">Jhony H. Giraldo</h1>
  <p class="profile-subtitle">Assistant Professor at Télécom Paris, Institut Polytechnique de Paris</p>
  <div class="academic-profile-grid">
    <div class="profile-copy">
      <p>I am an Assistant Professor in Machine Learning and Computer Vision at <a href="https://www.telecom-paris.fr/en/home">Télécom Paris</a>, <a href="https://www.ip-paris.fr/en">Institut Polytechnique de Paris</a>. I work in the Information Processing and Communications Laboratory (LTCI), within the Multimedia team, and I am a member of the <a href="https://ellis.eu/">ELLIS Society</a>.</p>
      <p>My research focuses on <strong>machine learning</strong> and <strong>signal processing</strong> for relational data, including graphs and higher-order structures. I am also interested in applications in computer vision, circuit design, environmental monitoring, materials analysis, physical systems, and underwater acoustics.</p>
      <p>I received my PhD in Applied Mathematics from La Rochelle Université in 2022. Before my doctoral studies, I worked on graph signal processing at the University of Delaware and completed my MSc and BSc degrees at Universidad de Antioquia, Colombia.</p>
